fusions.name: Snagged on the Scent
fusions.desc: Casts a musk-baited hook at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Torn Free
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike that rips the barb back out, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Led by the Nose
fusions.desc: A baited reek pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Stays In
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
